module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input w,
  input R,
  input E,
  input L,
  output reg Q
);

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    case ({E, L, R})
      3'b1??: Q <= w;        // E=1: Update Q with w
      3'b01?: Q <= 1'b0;     // E=0, L=1: Reset Q to 0
      3'b001: Q <= 1'b1;     // E=0, R=1: Set Q to 1
      default: Q <= Q;       // Default: Retain previous value
    endcase
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input [7:0] code,
  output reg [3:0] out,
  output reg valid
);

  reg [1:0] count;

  always @(*) begin
    case (1'b1)
      code[0]: begin out = 4'd0;   count = 2'd0; end
      code[1]: begin out = 4'd1;   count = 2'd0; end
      code[2]: begin out = 4'd2;   count = 2'd0; end
      code[3]: begin out = 4'd3;   count = 2'd0; end
      code[4]: begin out = 4'd4;   count = 2'd0; end
      code[5]: begin out = 4'd5;   count = 2'd0; end
      code[6]: begin out = 4'd6;   count = 2'd0; end
      code[7]: begin out = 4'd7;   count = 2'd0; end
      default: begin out = 4'd0;   count = 2'd0; end
    endcase
  end

  always @(*) begin
    valid = (code != 8'b0);
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input reset,
  output reg [3:0] q
);

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset) begin
      q <= 4'b0;
    end else begin
      if (q[0] == 1'b0) begin
        q <= 4'b0001;
      end else begin
        q <= q >> 1;
      end
    end
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input shift_ena,
  input count_ena,
  input data,
  output reg [3:0] q
);

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (count_ena) begin
      q <= q;
    end else begin
      if (shift_ena) begin
        q <= {q[2:0], data};
      end else begin
        q <= {data, q[3:1]};
      end
    end
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input areset,
  input load,
  input ena,
  input [3:0] data,
  output reg [3:0] q
);

always @(posedge clk or negedge areset) begin
  if (!areset) begin
    q <= 4'b0;
  end else begin
    if (ena) begin
      if (load) begin
        q <= data;
      end else begin
        q <= q;
      end
    end else begin
      q <= q;
    end
  end
end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input in,
  input [3:0] state,
  output reg [3:0] next_state,
  output out
);

  // State register with synchronous reset to one-hot S0
  always @(posedge in) begin
    if (state != 4'b0000)
      state <= state;
    else
      state <= 4'b0000;
  end

  // Next state logic (default to current state)
  always @* begin
    case (state)
      4'b0000: next_state = 4'b0000; // S0 → S0 (example)
      4'b0001: next_state = 4'b0001; // S1 → S1 (example)
      4'b0010: next_state = 4'b0010; // S2 → S2
      4'b0011: next_state = 4'b0011; // S3 → S3
      4'b0100: next_state = 4'b0100; // S4 → S4
      4'b0101: next_state = 4'b0101; // S5 → S5
      4'b0110: next_state = 4'b0110; // S6 → S6
      4'b0111: next_state = 4'b0111; // S7 → S7
      4'b1000: next_state = 4'b1000; // S8 → S8
      4'b1001: next_state = 4'b1001; // S9 → S9
      default: next_state = 4'b0000; // Handle undefined states
    endcase
  end

  // Output logic: 0 in lower 2 bits (1.x pattern)
  assign out = ~next_state[3];

endmodule
